title: Orecchiette with Turnip Greens and Sausage
author: Lorenzo
description: Puglia on a plate: bitter cime di rapa, crumbled sausage and a hint of chili.
steps: Brown the crumbled sausage in a little of the oil and set aside.
Boil the turnip greens in salted water for 5 minutes, then add the orecchiette to the same pot and cook until al dente.
Meanwhile warm the rest of the oil with the garlic and chili.
Drain the pasta and greens, toss them in the garlic oil with the sausage and a splash of the water, and serve with pecorino.
